Howard Riley (18 August 1938 – 8 January 2026) was an English footballer who played in the Football League for Barrow, Leicester City and Walsall. He died on 8 January 2026, at the age of 87.
Honours
Leicester City
*FA Cup runner-up: 1960–61, 1962–63
